We're holding our Fibonacci support area however, but any break below 13 dollars and 30 will make this 1-2 setup that we're tracking here on the Coinbase chart less likely. I have to repeat it again. It is already not a high probability wavecount because on the Binance chart, as you know and I've marked that on our daily chart on the Binance chart, the correction already invalidated this one-two setup, right that we've been tracking a one-two setup here. So you see the Binance low was at 830 roughly on the 10th of October. So it- you know it's just a problem generally right? And then however with a swift recovery. But we remain below critical resistances. I know it's frustrating. LingQ is still in my opinion one of the most stable let's say a more reliable structures, that doesn't mean it's, you know... It still is kind of a... It's an altcoin chart, what can I say, it's an altcoin chart and we need to take it level by level, as always with altcoins, you know, and we need a break above the nearest trend line. Yeah, so we need a break above this trend line, which is coming in around $21, as a first indication we're breaking out and then a break above round trend line which is coming in around $21 at the first indication we're breaking out and then a break off around about $27.50 that would be our next signal that we in a breakout towards $47. I know it doesn't sound right to talk about that while we are in a correction, but often, often when the sentiment is really bearish, that is when reverses happen. So I just want to everybody aware of it but I don't call a low at this point because the local downtrend is still unfolding. So a first signal that we're getting back into a local uptrend would be a break above this nearest trend line so I want to see a move above the $21.50 $21.60 level as a first indication circle wave three has started now let's also take a look at the smaller time frame because we have broken now below the 10th of october low at least here on the coin based chart that means simply that wave two is still extending yeah that wave two much has bottomed but it's still simply extending in a W,X,Y,X Z structure here. Now, so this is the complex correction we've been tracking w x, y, very complex correction. Then the X wave was the triangle. And then the Z wave could complete this entire move. We've even now broken below the tenth of October or at least here on the Coinbase chart. So you know, at any point, we could be turning around, but we could have done that here as well. But I said to you, look, we only have three wave movements to the upside everywhere, and have not even broken above this resistance area that we talked about last week, so I'm going to remove it now. I also am going to remove micro-support. So yeah, earliest indication now that it low of sorts has performed would be a break above $17.65 which is the last swing high that formed here on the 2nd of November.
